MEMORY.md loads in main session only; cron→automations naming; MIT-0.
Address ClawHub security review: remove always:true, document that cron jobs use OpenClaw built-in scheduler (not OS-level), add security note about MEMORY.md and PII
v3: Topic-based working memory, preset system (minimal/standard/full), onboarding flow, OpenClaw Dreaming integration, v2-to-v3 migration guide
Fix broken GitHub links, remove self-referential integration bullets, clarify that extension dirs are optional, consolidate related-skills section

Updated description: clarifies single-agent architecture positioning vs shared multi-agent memory systems
Initial release: tiered daily/weekly/monthly/yearly notes with distillation routines and lazy loading
